title: Art
script_notes: Production note: the staff meeting said one statement is enough. See Booklet issues, item 3.
script_graphic_directions: Graphic: four categories with an example image each.
Graphic: checklist builds one line at a time.

shots.framing: B-roll: a framed piece hung on the judging wall, judge leaning in.
shots.camera: Slow push-in toward the framed piece as the judge leans in
shots.storyboard_caption: Cold open: framed piece on the judging wall, judge leans in

shots.framing: Full-screen shared title card

graphics.anim: Red band sweeps up at -9° (10 frames), shield scales 0.9→1.0, text tracks in from right 30 px

shots.transition_in: Hard cut on a music hit
shots.storyboard_caption: Shared title card (from the graphics kit)

shots.framing: Full-screen category card

graphics.title: ART
graphics.subtitle: DRAWING · WATERCOLOR · OIL OR ACRYLIC · MONO
graphics.anim: Black band wipes down at -9° (10 frames), title punches in 1.15→1.0 scale (8 frames), subtitle letter-spaces in, small logo fades in bottom right

shots.framing: Medium two-shot, P1 left, P2 right, shield logo soft on the wall behind
shots.camera: Locked off with a slow 3% push-in across the shot

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: Your art gets judged before you say a word. So let's make sure it doesn't lose points before anyone looks.

graphics.anim: Red strip wipes in from left, then black bar unrolls right (8 frames); reverse to exit

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P2, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: Welcome to the SoCal Classic Fine Arts explainers. This one's for artists.

shots.storyboard_caption: Coverage for frame 3: Two-shot, name bars come up

shots.framing: B-roll: four categories, one example each
shots.camera: Four tiles pop in one by one, 0.25 s apart, with a 6% scale-up

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: There are four. Drawing, Watercolor, Oil or Acrylic, and Monochromatic Drawing.

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: Monochromatic is Junior and Senior High only.

shots.storyboard_caption: Graphic: four categories, one example each

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P1, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: Each school can enter three students per category. And you can enter up to two pieces.

shots.storyboard_caption: Coverage for frame 4: Graphic: four categories, one example each

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P2, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: Drawing means charcoal, pencil or ink. Elementary can use one color or lots of colors.

shots.storyboard_caption: Coverage for frame 4: Graphic: four categories, one example each

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P1, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: Monochromatic means one color only. Think black on white, or white on black. Ink, pencil or charcoal.

shots.storyboard_caption: Coverage for frame 4: Graphic: four categories, one example each

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P2, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: Watercolor goes on real watercolor paper. Watercolor pencils are fine.

shots.storyboard_caption: Coverage for frame 4: Graphic: four categories, one example each

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P1, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: But you have to wash water over the whole piece. If you don't, it counts as a drawing, and it's disqualified.

graphics.anim: Slides in from right 60 px with 6-frame ease-out, small 1.05 scale pop, slides out at the end

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P2, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: And in watercolor, no tempera, no airbrush and no ink.

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P1, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: Oil or acrylic goes on canvas, canvas board, bristol board or heavy paper. No airbrush there either.

shots.framing: Full-screen Shield Classic checklist

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: It has to be your own original work, made since last year's competition.

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: Getting advice is fine. Copying another artwork or photo in the same medium is not.

graphics.title: THE BIG RULES
graphics.anim: Header bar slides in from left; unchecked items sit at 40% opacity; each item gets a red check pop and goes to full opacity at its build_at time (seconds from shot start)

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P2, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: It has to be flat. No layers, no cut paper.

graphics.title: THE BIG RULES
graphics.anim: Compact panel on the right third of frame over the speaker shot; items already checked show ticked; new items tick at build_at

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P1, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: And it has to be totally dry. Wet art is disqualified.

graphics.title: THE BIG RULES
graphics.anim: Compact panel on the right third of frame over the speaker shot; items already checked show ticked; new items tick at build_at

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P2, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: Your subject doesn't have to be sacred. But no movie stars, no animation, and nothing mystical, pagan or worldly.

graphics.title: THE BIG RULES
graphics.anim: Compact panel on the right third of frame over the speaker shot; items already checked show ticked; new items tick at build_at

shots.framing: Full-screen Shield Classic checklist

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: Mat it or frame it, or you lose three points. Keep the frame simple.

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: A framed piece needs a hanger on the back, ready to hang.

graphics.title: YOUR CHECKLIST
graphics.anim: Header bar slides in from left; unchecked items sit at 40% opacity; each item gets a red check pop and goes to full opacity at its build_at time (seconds from shot start)

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P1, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: On the back, add a three-by-five card, face down. Put your full name, school, grade and category on it.

graphics.title: YOUR CHECKLIST
graphics.anim: Compact panel on the right third of frame over the speaker shot; items already checked show ticked; new items tick at build_at

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P2, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: Then three judging sheets, stapled, in a plastic sleeve on the back. No judging sheets, and you're disqualified.

graphics.title: YOUR CHECKLIST
graphics.anim: Compact panel on the right third of frame over the speaker shot; items already checked show ticked; new items tick at build_at

shots.framing: Medium close-up on P1, eyeline just off camera

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: Last, attach an Artist's Idea Statement to each judging sheet. Tell us where your idea came from and how you developed it.

graphics.title: YOUR CHECKLIST
graphics.anim: Compact panel on the right third of frame over the speaker shot; items already checked show ticked; new items tick at build_at

shots.framing: Medium two-shot, P1 left, P2 right, shield logo soft on the wall behind
shots.camera: Locked off with a slow 3% push-in across the shot

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: Original. Flat. Dry.

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: Framed. Labeled.

shots.framing: Full-screen Shield Classic end card

lines.speaker: P2
lines.text: Questions? Email us. The address is on your screen.

lines.speaker: P1
lines.text: See you February twenty-fourth through the twenty-sixth at Pacific Baptist School!

graphics.anim: Red band drops in at -9 degrees (10 frames), shield fades up, QUESTIONS? then email then dates stagger in 6 frames apart; hold, then fade to black over the last 15 frames
